newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Globe to invest in new cable system.
newsitem.headline: Globe to invest in new cable system.

text.p: Globe Telecom said on Wednesday it would invest in a new cable system this year as part of its route diversity and capacity expansion.
The company said in a statement it would invest in the South East Asia-Middle East-Western Europe 3 system. The investment is part of the seven billion peso capital expenditure set for this year.

"With these developments, Globe Telecom further enhances its capacity to carry voice, data, voice and images via the fibre optic links connecting its facilities with that of other telecom carriers in North America, Asia-Pacific, Europe and the Middle East," the company said.
Last year, the company invested $13 million in the Trans-Pacific Cable 5 submarine cable and the Asia-Pacific Cable Network.
